reading.body:
LTM is an IT services firm with a marketing position in AI and almost no tracked AI footprint: one MCP server, no products, no cases.

The single MCP server is for Altmetric, a research-attention tracking service. That is a tool for measuring where scholarly work gets mentioned, not a model, not an inference platform, not a data center asset. It is the only concrete artifact the record attaches to the company.

The aliases tell the more useful story. LTIMindtree, L&T Infotech, LTI, and Mindtree are the same entity under successive names, the residue of a merger and a rebrand. A services company that has been renamed this many times is selling labor and integration, and its AI language is positioning rather than infrastructure.

Nothing here speaks to compute, buildings, or power. There is no facility, no capacity figure, no energy contract, no chip count. The data covers identity, founding, headquarters, and one registry entry, and it does not cover revenue, headcount, customers, or any physical asset. A reader should not infer from the absence of such records that LTM owns none, only that this dataset does not track them.

profile_text.body:
LTM, formerly LTIMindtree, describes itself on its website as an AI-centric global technology services company and a "Business Creativity partner" to large enterprises. The company says its technology and domain expertise combine to create new ways of working, new productivity paradigms, and new roads to value, and it positions itself for what it calls the "Agentic Enterprise era." The site states that LTIMindtree is now LTM and uses the tagline "It's time to Outcreate."

The company is a public company founded in 2001 and headquartered in Mumbai, India. Venu Lambu has been Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director since 2025-05-31. According to its Integrated Annual Report 2025-26, the LTM brand was unveiled on 2026-02-11, members approved the name change on 2026-03-13, and a fresh certificate of incorporation as LTM Limited followed on 2026-03-17. The report also states the company has over 700 clients in 40 countries. A Larsen and Toubro subsidiary, it has about 87,000 employees and is listed on BSE and NSE.

Among the company's tracked AI-related assets is an MCP server, com.altmetric.mcp/altmetric-mcp, described as an MCP server for Altmetric APIs that tracks research attention across news, policy, and social media. No lawsuits are recorded for the company.
